title: CRAMER: Control via Request-Aware Masking for Editing Recommenders
abstract: arXiv:2608.25370v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequential recommendation models, while powerful, have limited flexibility in responding to immediate user requests, making it difficult to adapt their recommendations to the user's timely interests. Unfortunately, existing user request adaptation methods often incur high computational overhead due to either 1) retraining the entire backbone network or 2) leveraging the inference ability of large language models (a.k.a. prompt engineering), limiting their applicability in large-scale recommendation services. This paper presents Control via Request-Aware Masking for Editing Recommenders (CRAMER), a framework that takes users' natural-language requests to immediately change sequential recommendation models' behavior. translated_title: 基于请求感知掩码的推荐系统编辑控制方法（CRAMER）
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.25370v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：顺序推荐模型虽然功能强大，但在响应用户即时请求方面灵活性有限，难以根据用户的实时兴趣调整推荐内容。不幸的是，现有的用户请求适应方法通常会产生高昂的计算开销，原因要么是1）重新训练整个骨干网络，要么是2）利用大型语言模型的推理能力（即提示工程），这限制了它们在大规模推荐服务中的适用性。本文提出了一种基于请求感知掩码的推荐系统编辑控制框架（CRAMER），该框架利用用户的自然语言请求来立即改变顺序推荐模型的行为。具体而言，受模型控制理论的启发，CRAMER将用户请求视为控制信号，通过掩码调制冻结的骨干参数，从而在避免昂贵成本的同时实现对多样化请求的即时适应。
tldr: CRAMER通过将用户自然语言请求作为控制信号，利用掩码技术调制冻结的推荐模型参数，实现无需重训练或大语言模型推理的即时推荐行为调整。
en_tdlr: CRAMER treats user natural-language requests as control signals to modulate frozen recommender parameters via masking, enabling instant adaptation without retraining or LLM inference.
